arxiv-1504-05038.title: Conservativity of embeddings in the λ ​ Π \lambda\Pi calculus modulo rewriting (long version)
arxiv-1504-05038.creator: Ali Assaf
arxiv-1504-05038.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Ali Assaf. The λ ​ Π \lambda\Pi calculus can be extended with rewrite rules to embed any functional pure type system. In this paper, we show that the embedding is conservative by proving a relative form of normalization, thus justifying the use of the λ ​ Π \lambda\Pi calculus modulo rewriting as a logical framework for logics based on pure type systems. This result was previously only proved under the condition that the target system is normalizing.

arxiv-1603-02057.title: Bootstrap percolation on geometric inhomogeneous random graphs Thanks: Most of the research was conducted during the first author’s stay at ETH Zürich. The first author was/is supported by Austrian Science Fund (FWF): P26826 and W1230, European Research Council (ERC): No. 639046, and Engineering and
arxiv-1603-02057.creator: Christoph Koch, Johannes Lengler
arxiv-1603-02057.description: Abstract . Geometric inhomogeneous random graphs (GIRGs) are a model for scale-free networks with underlying geometry. We study bootstrap percolation on these graphs, which is a process modelling the spread of an infection of vertices starting within a (small) local region. We show that the process exhibits a phase transition in terms of the initial infection rate in this region.

arxiv-1904-08161.title: Wave Turbulence of a Liquid Surface in an External Tangential Electric Field
arxiv-1904-08161.description: Abstract A direct numerical simulation of the interaction of plane capillary waves on the surface of a liquid dielectric in an external tangential electric field taking into account viscous forces has been performed. It has been shown that the interaction of counter-propagating nonlinear waves can generate a direct energy cascade.

arxiv-2003-09680.title: Borrowing from Supplemental Sources to Estimate Causal Effects from a Primary Data Source
arxiv-2003-09680.creator: Jeffrey A. Boatman, David M. Vock, Joseph S. Koopmeiners
arxiv-2003-09680.description: Abstract The increasing multiplicity of data sources offers exciting possibilities in estimating the effects of a treatment, intervention, or exposure, particularly if observational and experimental sources could be used simultaneously. Borrowing between sources can potentially result in more efficient estimators, but it must be done in a principled manner to mitigate increased bias and Type I error.

arxiv-2103-09986.title: High Pressure Phase Diagram of Beryllium from Ab Initio Free Energy Calculations
arxiv-2103-09986.creator: Jizhou Wu, Felipe González-Cataldo, Burkhard Militzer
arxiv-2103-09986.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jizhou Wu, Felipe González-Cataldo, Burkhard Militzer. We use first principles molecular dynamics simulations coupled to the thermodynamic integration method to study the hcp-bcc transition and melting of beryllium up to a pressure of 1600 GPa.

arxiv-2106-05055.title: Detecting Mesoscale Structures by Surprise
arxiv-2106-05055.creator: Emiliano Marchese, Guido Caldarelli, Tiziano Squartini
arxiv-2106-05055.description: Abstract The importance of identifying the presence of mesoscale structures in complex networks can be hardly overestimated. So far, much attention has been devoted to the detection of communities , bipartite and core-periphery structures on binary networks: such an effort has led to the definition of a unified framework based upon the score function called surprise , i.e.

arxiv-2111-08711.title: Two-step adversarial debiasing with partial learning - medical image case-studies
arxiv-2111-08711.creator: Ramon Correa, Jiwoong Jason Jeong, Bhavik Patel, Hari Trivedi, Judy W. Gichoya, Imon Banerjee
arxiv-2111-08711.description: Abstract The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare has become a very active research area in the last few years. While significant progress has been made in image classification tasks, only a few AI methods are actually being deployed in hospitals. A major hurdle in actively using clinical AI models currently is the trustworthiness of these models.

arxiv-2202-09759.title: A Tseng type stochastic forward-backward algorithm for monotone inclusions
arxiv-2202-09759.creator: Van Dung Nguyen, Nguyen The Vinh
arxiv-2202-09759.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a stochastic version of the classical Tseng’s forward-backward-forward method with inertial term for solving monotone inclusions given by the sum of a maximal monotone operator and a single-valued monotone operator in real Hilbert spaces.

arxiv-2207-10046.title: Adaptive Step-Size Methods for Compressed SGD
arxiv-2207-10046.creator: Adarsh M. Subramaniam, Akshayaa Magesh, Venugopal V. Veeravalli Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
arxiv-2207-10046.description: Abstract Compressed Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) algorithms have been recently proposed to address the communication bottleneck in distributed and decentralized optimization problems, such as those that arise in federated machine learning. Existing compressed SGD algorithms assume the use of non-adaptive step-sizes (constant or diminishing) to provide theoretical convergence guarantees.

arxiv-2208-09065.title: Towards directional force sensing in levitated optomechanics
arxiv-2208-09065.creator: A. Pontin, T.S. Monteiro
arxiv-2208-09065.description: Abstract Levitated nanoparticles are being intensively investigated from two different perspectives: as a potential realisation of macroscopic quantum coherence; and as ultra-sensitive sensors of force, down to the zeptoNewton level, with a range of various applications, including the search for Dark Matter.

arxiv-2208-11222.title: Flow past an inclined spheroid in homogeneous and stratified environments
arxiv-2208-11222.creator: Sheel Nidhan, Jose L. Ortiz-Tarin, Sutanu Sarkar
arxiv-2208-11222.description: Abstract ABSTRACT Large eddy simulations (LES) are performed to study the flow past a 6:1 prolate spheroid placed at an angle of incidence of \alpha=10^{\circ} . The diameter-based Reynolds number ( \mbox{{Re}}=U_{\infty}D/\nu ) is set to a value of 5\times 10^{3} and four values of diameter-based Froude numbers ( \mbox{{Fr}}=U_{\infty}/ND ) are analyzed: \mbox{{Fr}}=\infty,6,1.9, and 1 .

arxiv-2307-01328.title: A maximal inequality for local empirical processes under weak dependence
arxiv-2307-01328.creator: Luis A. F. Alvarez, Cristine C. X. Pinto
arxiv-2307-01328.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Luis A. F. Alvarez, Cristine C. X. Pinto. We introduce a maximal inequality for a local empirical process under strongly mixing data. Local empirical processes are defined as the (local) averages 1 n ​ h ∑ i = 1 n 𝟏 { x − h ≤ X i ≤ x + h } f ( Z i ) \frac{1}{nh}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbf{1}\{x-h\leq X_{i}\leq x+h\}f(Z_{i}) , where f f belongs to a class of functions, x ∈ ℝ x\in\mathbb{R} and h > 0 h>0 is a bandwidth.

arxiv-2312-01209.title: A Method of Moments Approach to Asymptotically Unbiased Synthetic Controls
arxiv-2312-01209.creator: Joseph Fry
arxiv-2312-01209.description: Abstract A common approach to constructing a Synthetic Control unit is to fit on the outcome variable and covariates in pre-treatment time periods, but it has been shown by Ferman and Pinto 2021 that this approach does not provide asymptotic unbiasedness when the fit is imperfect and the number of controls is fixed.

arxiv-2403-12855.title: Uniform boundedness of semistable pure sheaves on projective manifolds
arxiv-2403-12855.creator: Mihai Pavel, Julius Ross, Matei Toma
arxiv-2403-12855.description: Abstract . We prove uniform boundedness statements for semistable pure sheaves on projective manifolds. For example, we prove that the set of isomorphism classes of pure sheaves of dimension 2 that are slope semistable with respect to ample classes that vary in a compact set K K are bounded.

arxiv-2408-15549.title: WildFeedback: Aligning LLMs With In-situ User Interactions And Feedback
arxiv-2408-15549.creator: Taiwei Shi, Zhuoer Wang, Longqi Yang *⋄, Ying-Chun Lin ∘, Zexue He Mengting Wan ⋄ , Pei Zhou ⋄ , Sujay Jauhar ⋄ , Sihao Chen ⋄ , Shan Xia ⋄ , Hongfei Zhang ⋄, Jieyu Zhao, Xiaofeng Xu ⋄, Xia Song ⋄, Jennifer Neville * ⋄, ⋄ Microsoft Corporation, ∘ Purdue University, Texas A&M University
arxiv-2408-15549.description: Abstract As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, aligning these models with human preferences has emerged as a critical challenge. Traditional alignment methods, relying on human or LLM annotated datasets, are limited by their resource-intensive nature, inherent subjectivity, misalignment with real-world user preferences, and the risk of feedback loops that amplify model biases.

arxiv-2410-19537.title: Coherent spectroscopy of a single Mn-doped InGaAs quantum dot
arxiv-2410-19537.creator: J. Filipovic, A. Kundu, N. K. Vij, S. Fécherolle, A. Lemaître, S. Gupta, O. Krebs
arxiv-2410-19537.description: Abstract Doping a self-assembled InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot (QD) with a single Mn atom, a magnetic acceptor impurity, provides a quantum system with discrete energy levels and original spin-dependent optical selection rules, which thus has large potential in quantum photonics, notably as a source of multi-entangled photons.

arxiv-2505-08846.title: Evaluating Simplification Algorithms for Interpretability of Time Series Classification
arxiv-2505-08846.creator: Brigt Håvardstun, Félix Martí-Perez, Cèsar Ferri, Jan Arne Telle
arxiv-2505-08846.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce metrics to evaluate the use of simplified time series in the context of interpretability of a TSC - a Time Series Classifier. Such simplifications are important because time series data, in contrast to text and image data, are not intuitively understandable to humans.

arxiv-2507-20679.title: Effects of Ill-Defined Domain of Definitions of the Parameter Operator on Berry Curvature and the Adiabatic Theorem
arxiv-2507-20679.creator: Georgios Konstantinou, Konstantinos Moulopoulos
arxiv-2507-20679.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive analytical study that extends the conventional formulation of Berry curvature, highlighting its derivation in the context of problematic domains of definition of the operators. Our analysis reveals that handling these domains carefully can have a substantial impact on Berry curvature, demonstrating that even Hamiltonians without explicit parameter dependence may exhibit nonzero Berry curvature.

arxiv-2508-02427.title: CABench : Benchmarking Composable AI for Solving Complex Tasks through Composing Ready-to-Use Models
arxiv-2508-02427.creator: Tung-Thuy Pham, Duy-Quan Luong, Minh-Quan Duong, Trung-Hieu Nguyen, Thu-Trang Nguyen ∗ , Son Nguyen, and Hieu Dinh Vo
arxiv-2508-02427.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tung-Thuy Pham, Duy-Quan Luong, Minh-Quan Duong, Trung-Hieu Nguyen, Thu-Trang Nguyen ∗ , Son Nguyen, and Hieu Dinh Vo. Composable AI offers a scalable and effective paradigm for tackling complex AI tasks by decomposing them into sub-tasks and solving each sub-task using ready-to-use well-trained models. However, systematically evaluating methods under this setting remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce CABench , the first public benchmark comprising 70 realistic composable AI tasks, along with a curated pool of 700 models across multiple modalities and domains.

arxiv-2510-15983.title: Ontologies in Motion: A BFO-Based Approach to Knowledge Graph Construction for Motor Performance Research Data in Sports Science
arxiv-2510-15983.creator: Sarah Rebecca Ondraszek, Jörg Waitelonis, Katja Keller, Claudia Niessner, Anna M. Jacyszyn, Harald Sack
arxiv-2510-15983.description: Abstract An essential component for evaluating and comparing physical and cognitive capabilities between populations is the testing of various factors related to human performance. As a core part of sports science research, testing motor performance enables the analysis of the physical health of different demographic groups and makes them comparable.

arxiv-2512-05012.title: Factuality and Transparency Are All RAG Needs! Self-Explaining Contrastive Evidence Re-ranking
arxiv-2512-05012.creator: Francielle Vargas, São Paulo State University, Daniel Pedronette
arxiv-2512-05012.description: Abstract . This extended abstract introduces Self-Explaining Contrastive Evidence Re-Ranking (CER), a novel method that restructures retrieval around factual evidence by fine-tuning embeddings with contrastive learning and generating token-level attribution rationales for each retrieved passage. Hard negatives are automatically selected using a subjectivity-based criterion, forcing the model to pull factual rationales closer while pushing subjective or misleading explanations apart.

europmc-pmc5739437.description: Introduction Disability and poverty are believed to operate in a cycle, with each reinforcing the other. While agreement on the existence of a link is strong, robust empirical evidence substantiating and describing this potential association is lacking. Consequently, a systemati

pmc-10556576.title: Ribosome-binding antibiotics increase bacterial longevity and growth efficiency
pmc-10556576.creator: Emily Wood, Hinrich Schulenburg, Philip Rosenstiel, Tobias Bergmiller, Dyan Ankrett, Ivana Gudelj, Robert Beardmore
pmc-10556576.description: SignificanceIt is often assumed that antibiotics are detrimental to bacterial lifestyles. While there is literature describing alternative perspectives on the function of antibiotics, this belief has likely perpetuated because of the limited way laboratory tests are designed for antibiotic function whereby short-term growth inhibition assays are the norm, by far.

pmc-11521841.title: An adolescent girl with syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion preceding the diagnosis of olfactory neuroblastoma – a case report
pmc-11521841.creator: Sabitha Sasidharan Pillai, Jerrold L. Boxerman, Jan C. Groblewski, Bradley D. DeNardo, Mohammed K. Faizan, Lisa Swartz Topor, Renee Robilliard, Monica Serrano-Gonzalez
pmc-11521841.description: ObjectivesWe present an adolescent in whom olfactory neuroblastoma (ONB) was detected on follow-up magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) 2.5 years after SIADH diagnosis. Our case contrasts prior pediatric reports in which ONB and SIADH were diagnosed concurrently.Case presentationA previously healthy 13-year-old girl was found to have SIADH during evaluation for restrictive eating.

pmc-11634749.title: Negative response to immunotherapy in dMMR or MSI-H gastric cancer with APC and PTEN mutations: a case report
pmc-11634749.creator: Jiang Liu, Xiumei Zhang, Qun Ren, Chuanjun Song, Jianhe Yu, Yin Cai, Dadong Chen
pmc-11634749.description: BackgroundMicrosatellite instability-high (MSI-H) or deficient mismatch repair (dMMR) represents a distinct molecular phenotype observed in malignant tumors. These tumors typically exhibit high levels of programmed cell death 1 ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression and high tumor mutational burden (TMB), resulting in an enhanced response to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) therapy.

pmc-12568074.title: Prognostic Significance of CRP/Albumin, D-Dimer/Albumin, D-Dimer/Fibrinogen Ratios and Triglyceride-Glucose Index in Crimean–Congo Hemorrhagic Fever: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-12568074.creator: Nurten Nur Aydın, Murat Aydın, Jeronimo Alencar, Sergio Lisboa Machado
pmc-12568074.description: Background: Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) is a severe zoonotic viral infection with high mortality rates. This study aimed to examine the prognostic value of new-generation inflammatory markers—CRP/albumin ratio (CAR), D-dimer/albumin ratio (DAR), D-dimer/fibrinogen ratio (DFR), and triglyceride-glucose index (TGI)—in predicting mortality among patients diagnosed with CCHF.

pmc-12644976.title: Comparative outcomes of excision and active surveillance for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia 2 in women under 35: a single institutional retrospective study
pmc-12644976.creator: Jihyun Lee, Mi Song Kim, Ju-Won Roh, Kyung Hee Han
pmc-12644976.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to compare the outcomes of excision (conization) and active surveillance in women under 35 years of age diagnosed with cervical intraepithelial neoplasia 2 (CIN 2) on disease regression to normal cervical cytology and the effectiveness of nonsurgical management.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study was conducted at CHA University Ilsan Medical Center.

pmc-12702630.title: Radiological Differentiation of Pituitary Adenomas From Other Sellar Masses: A Systematic Review
pmc-12702630.creator: Rahul Goyal, Ingyin Khaing, Ajay Kausheic Madhusuthanan, Dimple, Gourav Garg, Summayya Anwar
pmc-12702630.description: Sellar masses frequently share overlapping magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) appearances, yet management and prognosis vary across entities such as pituitary adenoma, Rathke cleft cyst (RCC), and craniopharyngioma. Improving preoperative discrimination would support surgical planning and endocrine outcomes. This review synthesizes comparative radiologic features and adjunct sequences that differentiate sellar masses and appraises the methodological quality of recent studies.

pmc-13261154.title: Konno-Rastan aortoventriculoplasty after transcatheter aortic valve replacement explant for aortic annular enlargement
pmc-13261154.creator: Alex Nantsios, Tsuyoshi Kaneko
pmc-13261154.description: c annular enlargement has nearly doubled from 2015 to 2023 (6% to 13%), as the concept of patient-prosthesis mismatch and valve-in-valve transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) expands.1 The Konno-Rastan aortoventriculoplasty, introduced in 1975 by Konno and Rastan,2,3 provides true enlargement of the subvalvular, annular, and supravalvular components of the aortic root.

pmc-13349137.title: Contextual image caption creation using object positional embedding and generative models
pmc-13349137.creator: Muhammad Danyal, Muhammad Roman, Abdul Shahid, Muhammad Yahya
pmc-13349137.description: Automated image captioning remains a challenge, as it enables machines to generate context-aware textual descriptions of visual content. Traditional deep learning approaches often rely on lexical overlap and fail to capture semantic relationships among objects, leading to captions that lack contextual richness. This study proposes an encoder–decoder framework that integrates YOLOv5 with a generative transformer to generate descriptive image captions.

pmc-13449015.title: Pre‐Exercise Galactose or Lactose Reduces Glycaemic Excursions During Exercise in Adults With Type 1 Diabetes: A Randomised, Double‐Blind, Crossover Trial
pmc-13449015.creator: Karoline R Schmidt, Rakel F Johansen, Simon B Riis, Mads S Larsen, Henrik Støvring, Gareth A Wallis, David Rowlands, Lars C Gormsen, Esben Søndergaard
pmc-13449015.description: AimsTo test whether pre‐exercise galactose and lactose reduce glycaemic excursions during exercise compared with dextrose while maintaining protection against hypoglycaemia compared with placebo in adults with Type 1 diabetesMethodsIn a randomised, double‐blind, 4‐condition crossover trial, 14 adults with Type 1 diabetes completed four 60‐min cycling sessions. Thirty minutes before exercise, participants consumed 20 g of dextrose, lactose, galactose, or placebo.

pmc-13466654.title: Micro-CT-Based Experimental Study on the 3D Structure–Electrical Conductivity Relationship of Metal-Coated Woven Fabrics
pmc-13466654.creator: Magdalena Tokarska, Adam K. Puszkarz, Marcin Makówka
pmc-13466654.description: HighlightsX-ray micro-computed tomography enables characterization of the structure–conductivity relationship in metal-coated fabrics.Fabric pore structure shows a stronger relationship with electrical conductivity than coating thickness.Increase in pore sizes in woven fabrics may increase in-plane electrical anisotropy.Extreme electrical resistance values occur along the warp and weft directions.Electrical anisotropy should be considered in metal-coated woven fabric design.

pmc-13470121.title: Dielectric-dependent hybrid functional based on meta-GGA
pmc-13470121.creator: Stefan Riemelmoser, Xun Xu, Alfredo Pasquarello
pmc-13470121.description: Semilocal density functionals such as the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functional substantially underestimate experimental band gaps. Hybrid functionals address this band gap problem by admixing a fraction of Fock exchange to semilocal exchange. The optimal mixing parameter depends on the specific material and can be identified as the inverse dielectric constant (dielectric-dependent hybrid functional, DDH).

pmc-13641202.title: Clinical and Population-Specific Insights Into Inherited Retinal Dystrophies From Whole-Exome Sequencing of the Polish Cohort
pmc-13641202.creator: Katarzyna Ognik, Ewelina Cholewińska, Ewelina Witkowska, Przemysław Sołek, Bartosz Sołowiej, Kamil Jonak, Agata Pietras-Baczewska, Beata Gajda-Deryło, Robert Rejdak, Katarzyna Nowomiejska
pmc-13641202.description: PurposeInherited retinal dystrophies (IRDs) are a diverse group of genetic disorders that lead to progressive vision loss, with non-syndromic and syndromic retinitis pigmentosa (RP) being one of the most common and genetically heterogeneous forms. This study aimed to explore the genetic landscape of IRDs in the white Polish cohort.
